title: The Unknown (FCP 2026)
synopsis: David Zimmerman, almost 40, is a photographer, but no one knows his work. When friends drag him to a wild party, he spots a woman in the crowd and can’t take his eyes off her; he follows her... A few hours later, David wakes up: he’s in the body of the unknown woman.

synopsis_lang.en: David Zimmerman, almost 40, is a photographer, but no one knows his work. When friends drag him to a wild party, he spots a woman in the crowd and can’t take his eyes off her; he follows her... A few hours later, David wakes up: he’s in the body of the unknown woman.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: David Zimmerman年近四十，是一名攝影師，但無人知曉他的作品。某天，朋友拉着他去參加一個狂野派對，他在人群中瞥見一名女子，目光再也移不開，於是尾隨着她...... 幾個小時後，David醒來，發現自己竟在那名陌生女子的身體裏。

cast: Léa Seydoux, Niels Schneider, Valérie Dréville, Lilith Grasmug
